decision_model: multi-objective, conditioned, thresholded, preservation-constrained pairwise comparison

revision_acceptance.evaluator_role: receives original and candidate without writer rationale that could bias judgment; compares against the governing brief and invariants
required_checks: no material regression on non-target critical dimensions
confidence clears threshold or routes to REVIEW_REQUIRED

anti_overoptimization: Do not optimize a scalar aggregate repeatedly until prose converges on the evaluator proxy.
Limit each revision pass to declared opportunities and a bounded edit budget unless the user asks for structural rewriting.
Track dimension deltas and preservation deltas, not only wins.
Use holdout project passages and user-approved samples to detect voice drift.
Inject clean controls where no revision should be preferred.
Use hard negatives for superficially polished but intent/voice/canon-damaging edits.
Require position-swapped pairwise consistency and abstention on unstable judgments.
Periodically compare accepted revisions to the pre-optimization project baseline for homogenization/drift.
prohibited_objectives: maximize similarity to a named author
prefer longer/more ornate/more concise prose irrespective of brief
